description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that defines a test suite for Git's ref store API. It sets up various Git references, manipulates them, and verifies their states through assertions, utilizing an external library ./test-lib.sh and a test tool 'test-tool ref-store'.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success; runs the specified commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the previous command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
